title: Materialize Pkl-declared Vaporize tool families
description: Advance the proven tool-family projection into build and installation materialization: build each declared source product, install it under its projected debug or release executable identity, and preserve platform-specific executable and PATH behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize consumes a selected Pkl family and variant for build or install, not only plan output.
The source SwiftPM product may differ from the projected installed executable name without weakening SwiftCLIInstaller validation.
Windows appends .exe at the filesystem boundary while the canonical identity remains platform-neutral; macOS and Linux retain their native executable spelling.
Debug installs include the temporal coordinate immediately before @ and release installs omit it.
Installation receipts use the Vaporize tool-materialization receptor with temporal versioning and include the projected destination.
Windows and macOS tests prove build, install, collision, replacement, and PATH discovery behavior.
